empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a block of instructions injected into an agent's prompt. Create one or import it from a file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit it or preview how the agent receives it.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes (2–64 characters).
config.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2–64 characters.
config.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive: when the agent should apply this skill and what it must check. This is the skill's interface.
config.bodyHint: Markdown. Saving a changed body or description creates a new version.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a block of instructions added to an agent's prompt.

preview.title: Preview
preview.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.
preview.trust: This skill came from outside. Its text goes into your agent's prompt, so read all of it before enabling.

stats.noAgents: No agent has this skill enabled.
stats.noFindings: No findings from runs that used this skill yet.
stats.correlation: Counts runs where this skill was present; it does not prove the skill caused them.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every save of the body or description snapshots it, so runs stay reproducible against the exact text they used.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This creates a new version with that text; history is kept.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: From a Markdown file or a skill archive. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.
import.skippedBody: Everything else in the archive is ignored. Scripts and other files are never run or read.
import.trust: Imported skills are someone else's instructions inside your agent's prompt. Read the whole body. It will be saved disabled.
import.name: Name
import.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive: when the agent should apply this skill and what it must check.
import.success: Imported "{name}". It is disabled until you enable it.

community.title: Search community skills
community.subtitle: Import vetted skills from public repos
